description: This PHP class defines an AWS client for the Application Migration Service (AWS MGN). It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various API operations such as archiving applications, creating and deleting resources, describing jobs, and other migration-related actions. The class itself does not contain method implementations; these are dynamically handled via magic methods, with annotations serving as documentation and interface hints.

classes.name: mgnClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Application Migration Service API, providing methods for managing migration resources.

methods.name: archiveApplication
methods.description: Archives an application within the migration service.

methods.name: archiveWave
methods.description: Archives a wave within the migration service.

methods.name: associateApplications
methods.description: Associates applications with other resources in migration context.

methods.name: associateSourceServers
methods.description: Associates source servers with applications or resources.

methods.name: changeServerLifeCycleState
methods.description: Changes the lifecycle state of a server, e.g., staging, cutover.

methods.name: describeJobLogItems
methods.description: Retrieves log items for a specific job.

methods.name: finalizeCutover
methods.description: Finalizes the cutover process for a migration.

methods.name: pauseReplication
methods.description: Pauses replication for a source server.

methods.name: putSourceServerAction
methods.description: Adds an action to a source server.

methods.name: putTemplateAction
methods.description: Adds an action to a template.

methods.name: removeSourceServerAction
methods.description: Removes an action from a source server.

methods.name: removeTemplateAction
methods.description: Removes an action from a template.

methods.name: resumeReplication
methods.description: Resumes replication for a source server.

methods.name: retryDataReplication
methods.description: Retries data replication for a source server.

methods.name: startReplication
methods.description: Starts replication for a source server.

methods.name: startTest
methods.description: Starts a test of the migration.

methods.name: stopReplication
methods.description: Stops replication for a source server.

methods.name: updateSourceServerReplicationType
methods.description: Updates the replication type for a source server.
